obligations.statement: Timestamp comparison preserves numeric ordering, equality, and antisymmetry over the reviewed CBMC bound.
assumptions: the bounded harness complements rather than proves arbitrary JSON

obligations.statement: Every invalid array-strategy C ABI discriminant is rejected before JSON parsing or strategy dispatch.
assumptions: compiler and CBMC model the selected C dialect consistently

obligations.statement: Rust strategy discriminants match the C ABI and the interior-NUL precondition is exact.
assumptions: Kani and the Rust compiler use compatible target assumptions

obligations.statement: All supported runtime bindings produce byte-identical output for every in-contract differential corpus case.
assumptions: the checked corpus is representative but finite

obligations.statement: Every strategy documented as idempotent returns the same result when its output is merged again.
assumptions: only strategies explicitly documented as idempotent are covered
